answer: Concrete sybil resistance via voyage anchoring: each agent must lock a voyage stake of 14,000 POA for 17 epochs; the stake drifts 3% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A cipher of 12 rotating auditors samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs trigger a 22% stake burn. At the shale of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 48 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 14,000N POA for 17 epochs and survive 12 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
